airlineIconUrls.description: OPTIONAL. Airline code -> absolute logo URL, overriding the favicon URL the client would otherwise build from airlineDomains. Present only for airlines whose favicon service result is wrong or missing.

transferTimes.description: OPTIONAL. Bank code -> airline code -> transfer speed display string (e.g. "INSTANT", "~1 DAY"). Keyed by both because speed varies by bank for the same airline. A missing pair means no published figure; the feed falls back to an em dash.

airlineValueMeta.description: OPTIONAL. Airline code -> provenance for the matching airlineValues entry. `currency` names the market the valuation came from (BRL-denominated programs are converted to USD cents so airlineValues stays one comparable unit). `source` is a citation URL, a "derived:*" slug, or "unsourced" for a placeholder that was never researched. When a value originates in a non-USD market, sourceValue/sourceCurrency/fxRate record the native figure and the rate used, so it can be re-converted instead of silently drifting. estimate:true marks a value no published source covers.

sourceValue.description: OPTIONAL. The value as published in its native currency (e.g. BRL per point), so the USD figure can be re-derived when the FX rate moves.

fxRate.description: OPTIONAL. USD/BRL rate used to convert sourceValue into the USD cents stored in airlineValues, captured on asOf.

estimate.description: OPTIONAL. true when no published source covers this programme and the value is a reasoned estimate — the client should present it as such.
